kind: provenance defect in a sealed bet's stratifying variable — filed AFTER the re-derivation exists, BEFORE any v3 battery statistic has run
subject: bet B6 (funnel homogeneity) and the variable it stratifies on

the_defect.finding: B6 stratifies on `source_funnel`. For the `rn` (reductions.network) funnel that field was never derived from source data: the site and its GitLab repo were unreachable, so membership was inferred topically at ingestion ('this is a canonical NP problem, so it is probably in the compendium'). The inference was disclosed four times in prose (K1, K2, K2b, the V2 report) and consumed as ground truth by three artifacts anyway. See methods-thread instance 9.
the_defect.magnitude: Re-derivation from source (2026-07-24) found 12 of 227 candidates present in the three networks — against 57 rows carrying `source_funnel: rn`. The labels were wrong in both directions: `min-sat`, `efficient-domination` (Perfect Code), `minimum-k-cut` (Graph k-Cut), `firefighter` (Saving k Vertices), `independent-dominating-set` (Kernel) are IN the networks and carried `ck`/`df`.

re_derivation.classic_network: 57 vertices, owner-supplied screenshot of Figure 1, verified programmatically
re_derivation.parameterized_network: 29 problems with W[1]/W[2] classification, Faour thesis recovered via the Wayback Machine (the live repo is unreachable from this environment)
re_derivation.new_field: `rn_membership: present | absent` with `rn_evidence` naming the network and that network's own label for the problem; `provenance_status: derived-rn-component`.

what_can_and_cannot_be_scored.scorable: rn_membership homogeneity — BINARY (in-network vs not), on source-derived labels. This is what B6's intent survives as.
what_can_and_cannot_be_scored.not_scorable: B6 as literally sealed says 'homogeneous across the six source funnels'. FIVE of the six funnel labels are still not source-derived — they are miner-attributed (each candidate cites the compendium it came from, which is better grounded than `rn` was, but is not the same as verified membership in an enumerated source list). A six-way funnel decomposition therefore CANNOT be honestly scored, and reporting one would repeat the exact defect this note records.
what_can_and_cannot_be_scored.ruling: B6 is scored on the binary rn_membership split and reported as such, with the six-way table explicitly WITHHELD rather than computed on unverified strata. The bet text in prereg_v9 is NOT edited.

why_re_sealing_is_legitimate.timeline: NO funnel-stratified v3 battery statistic has run. The v3 artifact is not frozen; V4 has not fired; no gradient, MCA, occupancy or factors number exists on any funnel split. The re-derivation is therefore genuinely pre-analysis for every prereg bet.
why_re_sealing_is_legitimate.independence: The re-derivation consumed NO v3 outcome data. Network membership is a property of three external documents, fixed before this program began, and was determined by set membership against them — it cannot have been tuned to a v3 result.
why_re_sealing_is_legitimate.contamination_disclosed: One statistic IS post-hoc and is labelled so: the V2 confirm-pass error-by-funnel table was recomputed on the derived labels AFTER the 272 verdicts existed. That table is QC, not a prereg bet, and it was always post-hoc — the re-scoring changes its strata, not its epistemic status. Result on true labels: rn-present n=24, value-error 8.3%; rn-absent n=248, value-error 4.4%; total 13/272 = 4.8% (invariant under relabeling, as predicted). NO stratum exceeds the 15% quarantine line, so kill-criterion 1 clears on source-derived labels rather than on inferred ones.

structural_fix_already_landed: All 227 provenance records carry machine-readable `provenance_status`. The battery MUST refuse to stratify on `source_funnel` while its status is not `derived`. A prose caveat cannot bind a consumer; a field can.
unchanged: No bet in prereg_v9 is edited, added, or removed; B1-B6 stand verbatim. B6's SCORING SURFACE is narrowed by this note to the variable that has source provenance. The frozen atlas.jsonl (6d53a4f1...) and atlas_v2.jsonl (784f4739...) remain byte-identical.
